claim: Short, capped or scripted recordings can pass what longer or human play breaks: replay whole recordings, replay every level, and do not treat a recording that ends early as completion.

evidence.text: Four minutes of owner play gave 2,485 game steps and the bolt; six scripted recordings gave about 550 steps each and no bolt.
A recording ending at 16% is not a completion even when every drawing entry type is reached.
The original verify replayed an RZX only to 6,000 frames; the rework replays each recording whole.
Per-level replays found the canvas clear covering the wrong span (stale pixels after a restart); the shorter recording had passed.
